description: filterByPeriod tests do not cover the edge case of entries that span midnight boundaries in daily/weekly filtering. No test exists for an entry starting on day 1 and ending on day 2 -- which is exactly the scenario described in EDGE-001. The current tests only use entries that start and end within the same day.
recommendation: Add test cases for filterByPeriod with entries crossing midnight to verify behavior and document whether callers are expected to pre-split entries.
